limitations.closure_criteria: Cryptographic proof profile and interoperable verification vectors are frozen and independently audited.
limitations.description: Proof digest verification is represented by an abstract verifier interface.

limitations.closure_criteria: Production datastore implementation passes fault-injection, recovery, concurrency and refinement suites.
limitations.description: Crash durability and concurrent serialization are not proven by the documentation reference state machine.

limitations.closure_criteria: A separate coordination profile is specified, implemented and audited where consensus is required.
limitations.description: Distributed consensus is outside the minimal Seed profile.

limitations.closure_criteria: The transition model and breach properties are mapped to semantic IDs and model-checked with retained evidence.
limitations.description: Universal breach propagation model checking is incomplete.

limitations.closure_criteria: Independent external audit report is published and bound to exact release bytes.
Migration coverage, schemas, requirements, conformance and formal model all pass independent clean-room audit.
limitations.description: The rc12 canonical model is a development scaffold, not a complete semantic migration.
